opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions max £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections max £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications max £5,000; Long-Term Research grants max £20,000; Research and Travel grants max £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating non-profit for at least 12 months) for exhibitions, catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, publications and collections; individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for the Research and Travel category. Not open to individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding the appreciation of sculpture. Categories: New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, Long-Term Research, and Research and Travel. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, rest of world up to £1,000, plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers whose interests lie in Henry Moore specifically (Studios & Gardens); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for six-week Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's facilities in Leeds or Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications for the next round will open in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: BA dissertation £250 cash prize; MA dissertation £250 cash prize; plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the value of £50, copies added to the Research Library, and publication of abstracts

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines at UK universities, for a dissertation submitted within the past academic year relating directly to sculpture.
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes for outstanding extended writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. Submissions for the 2026 prize will open in autumn.
